# OpenEcon.ai — AI Economic Data Platform

> Free, AI-powered natural-language search over 330,000+ economic indicators from FRED, World Bank, IMF, Eurostat, Statistics Canada, BIS, UN Comtrade, OECD, ExchangeRate-API, and CoinGecko. Ask a question in plain English and get instant charts plus CSV/JSON exports with full source provenance.

OpenEcon.ai routes each query to the right authoritative provider automatically, resolves the correct indicator, fetches and normalizes the series, and returns a chart, a narrative summary, and the exact source URL. No registration is required for basic queries.

## How to use

- [Web chat](https://data.openecon.ai/chat): Type a natural-language question and get charts + exportable data.
- [MCP server](https://data.openecon.ai/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint over Server-Sent Events (SSE), exposing the `query_data` operation. Install for Claude: `claude mcp add --transport sse openecon-data https://data.openecon.ai/mcp --scope user`
- [GitHub / pip](https://github.com/hanlulong/openecon-data): Source, installation, and API details.

## Example queries

- "US unemployment rate and inflation 2019–2024"
- "GDP growth for China, India, and Brazil 2018–2023"
- "Compare inflation rates between US, UK, and Japan"
- "EUR to USD exchange rate history"

## Data sources

- FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) — US economic data, 90,000+ series
- World Bank — global development indicators for 200+ countries
- IMF — international financial statistics
- UN Comtrade — international and bilateral trade flows
- Statistics Canada — Canadian economic and social data
- Eurostat — European Union statistics
- OECD — data for OECD member countries
- BIS (Bank for International Settlements) — central bank and financial stability data
- ExchangeRate-API — currency exchange rates
- CoinGecko — cryptocurrency prices and market data

## Part of OpenEcon.ai

OpenEcon.ai is an open-source toolkit for economics research. All projects live at [github.com/hanlulong](https://github.com/hanlulong).

- [OpenEcon.ai](https://openecon.ai/): Home of the OpenEcon open-source toolkit for economists.
- [stata-mcp](https://github.com/hanlulong/stata-mcp): MCP server that lets AI assistants run and inspect Stata.
- [econ-writing-skill](https://github.com/hanlulong/econ-writing-skill): Reusable writing workflows and prompt patterns for economists.
- [econ-slides-skill](https://github.com/hanlulong/econ-slides-skill): Generate economics presentation slides with AI.
- [econ-paper-review-skill](https://github.com/hanlulong/econ-paper-review-skill): AI-assisted review of economics papers.
